title: Summer Drought Water Stress (May 2024)
description: Pre-monsoon summer dry period with high thermal load (33°C). Root moisture is depleted (12.1%), requiring irrigation.

title: Active Monsoon Storm Infiltration (Jul 2024)
description: Intense monsoon downpour with 26.3 mm rainfall. Infiltration wavefront reaches 50 cm; irrigation not indicated.

title: Post-Monsoon Optimal Equilibrium (Oct 2024)
description: Balanced root moisture (19.2%) following the monsoon season. Steady moisture in the ideal crop growth band.

title: Rapid Percolation Wetting Front (Jul 2024)
description: Early monsoon wetting front where delayed percolation drives a sharp +3.2 pp rise in root-zone soil moisture.

title: Winter Drying Cycle (Feb 2024)
description: Post-rabi gradual desaturation cycle without precipitation. Root moisture hovering near the deficit threshold (16.2%).
